clips.title: The story
paras: Verna Furlbrow waits beside her broken wagon near Westfall’s northern border. Bandits drove her from her family’s pumpkin patch, and the road to Elwynn Forest has left her stranded.

Verna and her husband farmed pumpkins in northern Westfall until lawlessness drove them from their land. After outlaws took the farm, they loaded what they could onto their cart and set out for Elwynn Forest with their horse, Old Blanchy. Their wagon broke down just down the road from the abandoned Jansen Stead. Unable to repair the axle or continue, Verna now faces the elements, bandit raids, and scavengers. She depends on travelers to keep her household fed and guarded.

Verna still welcomes those who have been driven to the roadside. Known for creating Westfall Stew, she shares meals and warm fires with wandering transients and refugees who have suffered similar fates. To fill her cooking pot, she needs ingredients gathered from the fields, including boar snouts, murloc eyes, okra, and stringy vulture meat. She makes hearty meals for the destitute from what the harsh frontier provides.
